description:
lib.rs crate-level docs by client crate:

| Crate | Style |
|---|---|
| jmap-base-client | (proper //! docs with example) |
| jmap-tasks-client | //! with runnable rust,no_run example |
| jmap-mail-client | // line comment (NOT rendered on docs.rs) |
| jmap-chat-client | // |
| jmap-calendars-client | // |
| jmap-contacts-client | // |
| jmap-sharing-client | // |
| jmap-filenode-client | // |

The // comments are invisible on docs.rs. Users land on the crate's docs.rs page and see no description.

Fix: convert each `//` to `//!` and expand to a brief crate-level doc with at least an RFC pointer and a short rust,no_run example. Mechanical change, ~6 files.

Tied to JMAP-sc1b.X (7 of 8 client crates have no lib.rs doc-test) — addressing both together is one edit.
title: P2: 6 of 8 client crates use // line comments instead of //! crate docs (docs.rs visibility regression)
